## Slack talks to your agent

This is an **entry point**, not a tool. Your agent cannot call it; Slack calls it.

The address Slack needs is the **Production URL** on the *Slack Events* node below. Publish this workflow first, then create your Slack app — Slack checks the address the moment you create the app, and a workflow that is not published will fail that check.

It answers Slack in well under a second and does the slow thinking afterwards, because Slack gives up after three seconds and starts retrying.

Messages from bots are ignored on purpose. Without that, your agent's own replies would come straight back in and it would talk to itself until your Claude credit ran out.
